ops.body: Fixed by the v0.21.0 cut: both legacy latency sources are gone from the daemon-child spawn and trust paths. Gate verified: Owned.Spawn posix_spawns the target suspended and releases it only after in-place verification (internal/proc/spawn.go:102-127, posixspawn.go), and trust verification reads kernel-held audit tokens via task_name_for_pid/task_info and judges them in-process through csops_audittoken — internal/trust contains no os.Executable re-exec (serve.go:424's os.Executable is buildDigest self-identification for the owner record, not a verifier child). The /bin/sh wrapper survives only in the separate caller-owned NewGate adoption API, exactly as the lane states.
